request.amount_ada: ₳2,350,000 stated in anchor document; action metadata amount not stated in document context
deliverables: Frontend maintenance and cross-platform development for browser extension, web/PWA, iOS, Android, and beta channels
Backend infrastructure and operations including multi-region servers, Cardano nodes, DBSync, application servers, metadata aggregation, and monitoring
User support through Discord ticketing, Telegram, public channels, ecosystem support, wiki updates, and educational videos
Governance tooling enhancements including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and proposal creation
Independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics in February 2027 and August 2027
request.what: 12 months of operations, maintenance, and improvements for the Eternl non-custodial Cardano light wallet, including frontend and backend work, infrastructure, support, administration, and audits/oversight.

claims.claim: Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet for web, browser extension, Android, and iOS used for payments, staking, governance, and DApp interaction.
The proposal asks for ₳2,350,000 at about $0.1787 per Ada to cover approximately $420,000 of annual costs for 12 months.
The budget is allocated as 55% frontend, 25% backend, 5% support, 13% admin, and 2% audits.
Eternl plans to introduce Personal and Company Pro plans priced at $96/year and $360/year, and says about 5,500 paying users would cover the $420,000 annual cost.
The proposer says Eternl has about 100,000 browser extension installs and about 30,000 Android/iOS installs.
After withdrawal, the proposer says it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins in a public company wallet and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.
The audits allocation is for independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics, not technical security audits, with audits planned for February 2027 and August 2027.

The proposer commits to semiannual repayment checks using remaining treasury stablecoins and paid plan income, with surplus used to repay up to $420,000 in Ada and possible additional donations up to $210,000 worth of Ada.
The proposal is not milestone-based and is intended to ensure funds availability for a 12-month period.
The proposer says 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl and that Eternl has provided access across several platforms with basically zero downtime for over 5 years.

summary: The document presents a ₳2,350,000, 12-month operating-support request for Eternl, with a sustainability plan based on paid Pro subscriptions, public wallet monitoring, fund-use audits, and possible treasury repayment, but many adoption and operational impact claims are asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
